metadata.title: [Perf][SM70] DeepSeek-V4.1 decode: fuse attention prep and post kernels (VLLM_V41_FUSE_ATTN_PREP/POST, default off)
metadata.body:
Contributed by PLI Labs (Proprietary Legal Intelligence). Written with AI assistance (Claude Code).

**Depends on #1370** (PP2): this branch sits on it because both edit `V41Attention` in `model.py`; the change itself does not use PP.

## Purpose

At decode (1-8 tokens), `V41Attention.forward` launches four small kernels after `wq_b` (query RoPE; window `kv_norm`, RoPE and FP8 QDQ) and three after attention (window ring insert, inverse RoPE and the output FP8 QDQ in `project_output`). Each is a few microseconds and they run on every layer of every round.

- **`VLLM_V41_FUSE_ATTN_PREP=1`** (default off): `attn_fuse._attn_prep` does the four prologue steps in one Triton launch (1-6 tokens).
- **`VLLM_V41_FUSE_ATTN_POST=1`** (default off): `attn_fuse._attn_post` does the deferred window ring insert, the inverse RoPE and the QDQ in one launch (1-8 tokens); `_project_quantized` then runs `project_output`'s projections on the quantized output.
- Same arithmetic in the same order as the replaced kernels (`enable_fp_fusion=False`, the same reduction layouts), so outputs are bit-identical. Outside the token ranges, or when the wrapper declines (`return None`), the original kernels run.
- `vllm/envs.py`: the two knobs, with metadata and in the `compile_factors` ignore list.

Tests and checks (all new):

- `tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_small_fuse.py` (Triton interpreter): `_attn_prep` vs `_rotate` / `_short_rms` / `_qdq`, and `_attn_post` vs `_ring_insert` / `_rotate(inverse)` / `_qdq`, bit for bit, into NaN-poisoned buffers; zero rows, sub-floor QDQ groups, near-FP16-max values, positions past the RoPE table, invalid ring tokens.
- `tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_small_fuse_knob_off.py`: an AST proof that with both knobs off, `forward()` reduces to the base code and every other function, and the old kernel modules, are unchanged.
- `tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_small_fuse_sm70.py` -> `benchmarks/deepseek_v41/small_fuse_sm70_check.py`: compiles old and new kernels for sm_70 on the CPU; every FP32 add-reduction in a fused kernel uses a layout and axis the replaced kernels use, and ptxas reports no spills.
- `benchmarks/deepseek_v41/small_fuse_check.py`: the same bit checks on a GPU, eager and inside CUDA graphs with new inputs per replay.

## Test Plan

```bash
ruff check / ruff format --check   # ruff 0.14.0, changed .py files
python -m tools.generate_env_reference --check   # and the other four 1Cat reference checks
pytest -q tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_small_fuse_knob_off.py tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_small_fuse_sm70.py
TRITON_INTERPRET=1 pytest -q tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_small_fuse.py
python benchmarks/deepseek_v41/small_fuse_check.py --json small_fuse.json   # one V100
```

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Attention prologue | DeepSeek-V4.1 fp16 q / kv, 16 heads per rank, dim 512 | decode, 1-6 tokens, eager or CUDA graph, PREP on | `_attn_prep`; else the four original kernels | interpreter bit tests; sm_70 TTGIR layout check; GPU bit check (eager + graphs); measured on 8x V100 PP2 x TP4 | other head counts (TP other than 4) |
| Attention epilogue | same, window ring | decode, 1-8 tokens, POST on | `_attn_post` + `_project_quantized`; else the three original kernels | same | same |
| Knobs off | all | default | original code (AST-proved) | knob-off test | — |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

- Default enabled or opt-in: opt-in; both knobs default to `0`.
- Required CLI options and environment switches: `VLLM_V41_FUSE_ATTN_PREP=1`, `VLLM_V41_FUSE_ATTN_POST=1`.
- KV cache dtype used for the benchmark: the #1277 packed-KV default.
- Wheel SHA or source commit: measured on our build of the #1277 merge (`899e9ed33`) with the PP2 x TP4 port; this branch is the change alone on #1370, rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`.
- PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used: none (Triton kernels).
- User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence: below.
- Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons: unchanged.
- Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility: no variable renamed or removed.
- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: two tuning variables with metadata; references pass.
- Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows: none.
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: +2 registered, 0 unregistered reads.

## Test Result

**MEASURED, 2026-11-03,** 8x V100-SXM2-32GB, DeepSeek-V4.1 PP2 x TP4, one request, paired arms (both knobs on vs off): **-0.18 / -0.20 ms per round** at temperature 0 and **-0.12 / -0.29 ms per round** at temperature 1 (average about -0.19 ms; an A/A pair read -0.09 / -0.07, so this is a modest win); output texts identical 11/11; greedy check passed. Kernel times on one V100 (CUDA graph, 6 tokens): prologue 6.5 -> 3.5 us, epilogue 5.3 -> 3.3 us per layer.

**Re-run for this PR, 2026-11-05,** on this branch (on #1370, rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`):

- `small_fuse_check.py` on one V100-SXM2 (torch 2.10, Triton 3.6): 36 prologue cases, 40 epilogue cases and 12 CUDA-graph replays, **0 mismatches**.
- pytest: knob-off proof + sm_70 compile check, 6 passed; interpreter bit tests, 24 passed (CPU).
- the five 1Cat reference checks: all pass; ruff 0.14.0 `check` and `format --check`: pass.

Not re-run: timing and serving.

---
